adulthood taken as 18 years\"}}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"assessment of increased risk of LTBI (e.g., birthplace/residence in high-prevalence country, congregate living, exposure); defined in the separate 'Assessment of Risk' section\"}, \"quote\": \"populations at increased risk\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"confirmation patient is asymptomatic for tuberculosis (clinician assessment)\"}, \"quote\": \"asymptomatic adults at increased risk of latent tuberculosis infection (ltbi)\"}]}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"latent_tb_test\", \"window\": [\"{MY-100}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"screening for LTBI\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"the text states no screening interval; window approximates 'ever screened' and needs human review\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The adult age threshold (18) is derived; the section only says 'adults'.","Increased risk of LTBI is uncomputable from structured EHR data; the risk criteria live in a separate 'Assessment of Risk' section not included here.","Asymptomatic status requires clinical assessment and is encoded as uncomputable.","No screening interval or rescreening frequency is given; the numerator window approximates 'ever screened' and is flagged as derived for human review.","Test choice (TST vs IGRA) and follow-up/treatment of positive results are not specified and not represented.","The asterisk after 'May 2023' in the DATE field is unexplained in this section."]}
